description: Fork of exp475 (TinyMHLut backward_mode=soft, argmax single-row, 1.4962). Enables set_hard_sign_bwd(True): in the SOFT backward, build the softmax over INTEGER hamming scores (p=p_signs, exact exp-hamming kernel) instead of soft-magnitude p=p_signs*|d|/denom. The argmax FORWARD is sign-only -> bit-identical to exp475; this isolates the effect of hard vs soft signs on the BACKWARD gradient alone (TinyMHLut analog of exp500's hard_sign_ste for MatmulMHL). Input-grad Jacobian T_soft/denom^2 kept as STE surrogate (else hard signs -> zero input grad). vs exp475 1.4962.
